sentences.show: Two British warships ran into a French trap. One captain told the other to run, and stayed to fight five ships alone.
It happened on this day in 1794.
The 74s Alexander and Canada were sailing home to Britain.
At dawn, a squadron appeared. It was disguised as British.
Then it raised the French flag. Five ships of the line, against two.
Alexander was the slower ship. So Captain Bligh ordered Canada to break away and save herself.
Alexander was caught. Bligh drove off the first French ship, then the second.
By one o'clock, his sails were in rags, his masts shot through, and fires were burning below.
A court martial cleared him with honour.
And seven months later, at the Battle of Groix, the British took Alexander back.
Also on this day: a king gave ordinary people rights in the royal forests, and Canadians took Passchendaele.
